notes.title: Update 0.6.5: Lower Bridges, Bust Banks, and Save Mom!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello again Mom Savers![/h1][p][/p][p]This update brings our most complex level yet, a radiated town with [b]multiple paths[/b], each packed with unique themes and challenges that will even make Mom shiver as she drives through.[/p][p][/p][h2]🔥[b]Highlights[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New Level[/b]: Our biggest and most complex so far, with branching routes and fresh mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]New objective: [b]Lower the bridge[/b]. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/0d01cfdcf74cf55bf501fbf813b4f143ba1e3e1a.jpg"][/img][i]The motorhome can’t cross until players figure out how to lower the bridge.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New objective: [b]Destroy radiation pumps[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/b0bb00b184ed5db0874488d7f97ecad2692ab020.jpg"][/img][i]Some nasty polluted water is being pumped into the road, mom refuses to get the motorhome dirty. Destroy source of pollution to continue your journey.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New objective: [b]Destroy the bank.[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/5e5d0c9800cf6005b41253d885e44408618bfff8.jpg"][/img][i]Mom's needs to make a "withdraw" from the bank, she says is her retirement money. She refuses to continue until her kids get the money, one way or another.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New point of interest: [b]Self storage warehouse. [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/f2294493349430e702fe417130ee5b554abeb96c.jpg"][/img][i]Abandoned units may hold loot… or an unpleasant surprise.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]
Besides the highlights, these are the changes included in this release[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🆕Added[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added new component to create rope like behavior, used for cables and when lowering the bridge[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX for green goo and radiated splat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added buoyancy effect for objects in water.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Force Continue button on the game over flow so the server does not have to wait for a client[/p][/*][*][p]Added new ground textures, used mainly for the new level[/p][/*][*][p]Added custom laser particles for Bongo's weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added object pool for projectiles. This should help with performance[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]⚙️Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Changed level 04 to have many more enemies, making this a real rush level![/p][/*][*][p]Enemies no longer spawn after level is completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to pickable resource graphics.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved view transitions when going to and from the settings view to be faster and more snappy.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed meta map scale to fit all the levels in the region.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed ghost image when placing sentries or interactable (fuel barrels, scrap) to make them more noticeable.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked bullet trails.[/p][/*][*][p]Many changes to the amount of data we send over the network for enemies to reduce network lag.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded Unity version.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed volume probes in all levels, they where baking too much information and producing minimal visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unused packages and URP features[/p][/*][*][p]Meta Map light is now baked.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🔧 Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed portraits not animating[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where players will remain laying down after revive.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed muzzle flash not showing for player weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed smoke in missile silo.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed storage container not updating in the clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed road selector effect not showing properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lens distortion main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some small environment objects having very tiny colliders.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy pathfinding not working when some obstacles were destroyed.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
That’s it for this week’s release! We hope this new level feels different, offers higher replayability, and surprises you with fresh mechanics to make saving Mom even more challenging.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, for now some extra images for this update:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/ca6af049a0f54a79f0e15c5cdcb39b6c517ab369.jpg"][/img][i]Mom's 4th favorite diner[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/da6fe264c15633c5af8451ee5f4661dbc365d0bc.jpg"][/img][i]They were normal bulls, until someone feed them...[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Help save Mom by wishlisting today, she promises cookies if you do!*[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3470800/Save_Mom/"][/dynamiclink] [i]*Unfortunately cookies are not included with the purchase of the game :([/i] [/p]

notes.title: Update 0.6.4: Settings included
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings from Mom![/h1][p][/p][p]First of all, a big thanks to everyone who has played [i]Save Mom[/i]! Your feedback has been super valuable and helps us keep improving the game.[/p][p]This update introduces a basic [b]Settings Menu[/b], so you can tweak graphics options and get smoother performance on different hardware.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Highlights[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]NEW Main Menu [/b]with settings and credits views[b].[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Settings to configure several graphics options![/p][/*][*][p]Several improvements to materials, decals and network parameters to reduce lag[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/abba7aea411e7a4754bdd875fbed3fd522bc4b6b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🆕Added[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New street decals to show intersections and road signs[/p][/*][*][p]Added new settings menu with transitions to Credits and Settings view[/p][/*][*][p]Added several configurable options for graphics[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]⚙️Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Tweaks to enemies speed making the smaller run faster than the small ones[/p][/*][*][p]Changed range of light produced by projectiles[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked lighting settings for several objects, this should help with performance[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🔧 Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed enemies running diagonally toward targets[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player death animation not playing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ragdoll bugs that caused enemies to clip through the floor or get dragged by players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players sliding when dead[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some enemy animations not playing properly[/p][/*][/list][p]This is still just the beginning, more [b]network optimizations[/b] are on the way to make gameplay even smoother. We also plan to add the Settings Menu to the [b]pause screen[/b], so you can change options mid-game in a future update.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also been working hard on [b]new levels and visuals[/b], which we cannot wait to show soon!
Stay tuned, and keep saving Mom![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/f9494d1b37969eedb243b0ef11f6d45b0302214d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.6.2: I can see you update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello there Mom Savers[/h1][p][/p][p]This is a regular upgrade that contains requested features, fixes and quality of life improvements that should make the job of protecting mom easier and more interesting.[/p][p][/p][p]This is what is new:
[/p][h2][b]Highlights[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Players in HUD[/b] display for better team awareness. Now you can keep track of other players health and what special ability they have selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Many new [b]Mom dialogue variations[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]call to action[/b] visual element to easily see what mom needs[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned [b]player upgrade system[/b] to make the upgrades more meaningful[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🆕Added[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New crosshair for better aiming[/p][/*][*][p]Players are not visible in the radar[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips for character selection utilities to describe what each utility does.[/p][/*][*][p]Level obstacles with more variations now also show damage overlay[/p][/*][*][p]Added proper description for sentries[/p][/*][*][p]Added camera shake on obstacle destruction[/p][/*][*][p]More variations of level obstacle visuals[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]⚙️Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Player upgrades rebalanced[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked intersection objective wait time tweaked[/p][/*][*][p]Many stop zones are now objectives which makes it clearer to see why mom is stopping [/p][/*][*][p]Enemy mini map icons resized for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed “Caravan Upgrade Unlocked” to “Motorhome Upgrade Unlocked”[/p][/*][*][p]Aligned buttons in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized export of enemy character models. This reduced the size of the enemy characters by a great margin[/p][/*][*][p]Updated drone upgrade description to be more concise and clear.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced max asset sizes and removed unused terrain maps to reduce build size[/p][/*][*][p]Changed MedBay upgrade description[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🔧 Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some player upgrades not applying properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text in the build menu overflowing.[/p][/*][*][p]Level obstacles now properly destroyable and display correct visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed decals showing on wrong layer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed scrapyard animation issue on clients[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented multiple players from picking up the same object[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken portrait reference in meta map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed invite friends function on meta map (third invite button was not working)[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped enemies from climbing small objects[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That is all for this release, it includes the most commented things from your feedback and we hope to keep improving the game, so keep the suggestions coming! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/f9494d1b37969eedb243b0ef11f6d45b0302214d.png"][/img][/p][p]Until next time![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.6.0: The Motorhome May Stop, But You Don’t
notes.notes: [h1]Greetings Mom Savers[/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve got a big update packed with new features, improvements, and polish! Thanks to your feedback and playtesting, we’re shaping Save Mom into a richer, more fun experience. This version brings in fresh content, new ways to play, and loads of fixes.[/p][p]Let’s dive into what’s new![/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][h3]New level + new game mode[/h3][p]Introducing a fresh twist: the motorhome breaks down, and it’s up to you to defend Mom while it gets repaired. Build defenses, hold your ground, and watch your flanks, enemies can come from unexpected places in this dynamic new map.[/p][h3]Drone Upgrade[/h3][p]A new drone now hovers around Mom’s motorhome, scouting enemies and assisting in defense. It’s fast, deadly, and smart![/p][h3]Flare Launcher Upgrade[/h3][p]Auto-deploys flares when enemies get too close to Mom, distracting them in the heat of battle. Light up the night, stay alive![/p][h3]Level music is back![/h3][p]Defending Mom just got more immersive. We’ve added music to levels to enhance the atmosphere and pacing, with plans to expand this with more variety in future updates![/p][p][/p][h3]⚙️ Gameplay & UX Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Clients can now reconnect to a running session[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother loading screen transitions for joining players[/p][/*][*][p]Building menu now closes automatically after placing a building[/p][/*][*][p]You can now place pickables and close signs with the E key[/p][/*][*][p]Added camera shake and sound effects when placing sentries[/p][/*][*][p]Sentries now appear on the radar and have improved build/death animations[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI for upgrade selection and game over screens[/p][/*][*][p]Improved level selection clarity on the meta map (available, unavailable, completed)[/p][/*][*][p]Character selection backgrounds now match your player color[/p][/*][*][p]Changed “Roll” to “Dash” in the pause menu[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🔧 Fixes & Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed destroyed obstacles still blocking enemy movement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed leftover colliders from destroyed obstacles[/p][/*][*][p]Improved shooting transitions for Derek and SueAnn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missile sentry not disappearing when recycled[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed end horde mode spawning only one wave[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed caravan lights staying on during the day[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fuel pump interaction and abrupt coin sound ending[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player HP bar displaying decimals[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced flare brightness and fuel collection values[/p][/*][*][p]Updated visuals for explosions, intersections, and props[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level numbers not updating on the meta map[/p][/*][*][p]General lighting, terrain, and navigation fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s all for now! As always, we love hearing your thoughts. Your feedback helps us shape Save Mom into something even better. We’ve also been watching your streams and videos, and they’ve been both inspiring and incredibly helpful. Seeing how you play gives us new perspectives and ideas we hadn’t considered.[/p][p]Keep sharing your experiences, and keep protecting Mom. We’ll be watching (in a good way!)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/f9494d1b37969eedb243b0ef11f6d45b0302214d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Save Mom Update: Visible Mom, Upgrade Overhaul & Gold Economy!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1][p]We’re back with a brand new update for Save Mom, and this one adds a lot more personality, polish, and strategy.

[/p][h2]Mom Is Now Visible![/h2][p]Mom will now physically leave the caravan and walk to nearby points of interest, whether she's fixing her nails or taking a bathroom break in the middle of a desolate wasteland. This change brings her more to life and present as players move through the levels.

[/p][h2]Overhauled Caravan Upgrade System[/h2][p]We’ve revamped the upgrade screen! Gone is the placeholder UI, now you’ll find clearer upgrade paths, better visuals, and a much more informative and intuitive way to invest in your caravan.

[/p][h2]New Resource: Gold [/h2][p]Gold is now used to purchase upgrades. You’ll earn it after finishing levels, and leftover scrap is automatically converted into gold, making sentry refunds and resource spending far more strategic.

These systems will continue to evolve, but this is a major first step toward making caravan progression more meaningful.

[/p][h3]Full Changelog[/h3][p]
[b]New Features:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] New upgrade UI with better layout and feedback
[/p][/*][*][p] Added gold as an upgrade currency
[/p][/*][*][p] Scrap now converts to gold after each level using a ratio
[/p][/*][*][p] Mom now walks to points of interest during stops
[/p][/*][*][p] Upgrade parts now feature unique flavor text
[/p][/*][*][p] Rotation added to throwable objects
[/p][/*][*][p] Delay added when building sentries (especially helpful in multiplayer)
[/p][/*][*][p] Separate footstep system for Mom/NPCs
[/p][/*][*][p] Added upgrade sprites for missing parts (top turret, side turrets, etc)
[/p][/*][*][p] New objective type: Timed objectives. Used when mom is crazy doing something and players need to protect her for a set amount of time
[/p][/*][*][p] Character badge for vote indicators. Now is clearer to see what other players want for upgrades
[/p][/*][*][p] New scrap thumbnail sprite
[/p][/*][*][p] Now some objectives can be dismissed after completing them.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Tweaks & Improvements:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Rebalanced upgrade prices and effects
[/p][/*][*][p] Flare visuals and VFX improvements
[/p][/*][*][p] New atmospheric level music
[/p][/*][*][p] Terrain-based footstep system
[/p][/*][*][p] Faster game over animation
[/p][/*][*][p] Game over screen now has more space for player cards
[/p][/*][*][p] Level stop points now use the new mom interaction system
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Flare collision issues fixed
[/p][/*][*][p] Bullet decals missing from some buildings now appear
[/p][/*][*][p] Explosion VFX now triggers correctly when destroying obstacles
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed misaligned effect areas for oil/radiation pools
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed side turret rate of fire
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Bongo’s turret rotation sync
[/p][/*][*][p] Decal layering fix in level 2
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed level blockers to prevent out-of-bounds exploits
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved multiplayer object spawning reliability
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed dirt road decal showing over resources
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved loading screen readability (dynamic text color!)
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed caravan movement stuttering, specially when player and the caravan moved at the same time
[/p][/*][/list][p]
We’re super excited to hear your thoughts. Jump in, test the new systems, and let us know what you think!

Thanks for playing Save Mom!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3470800/Save_Mom/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
